turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hi, this is Maya, an AI assistant calling from Northgate Lettings about the enquiry you made on our website. Is now a good time?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes. Is the rent definitely fourteen hundred? My budget is really thirteen hundred.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: The rent is fourteen hundred a month and I'm not able to change that. Would you still like to see it, or would you rather leave it?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I think I'll leave it, to be honest. It's a stretch.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Understood. If anything else comes up in your budget the office can let you know. Thanks for your time.
